description: This file contains unit tests for the class {@link org.eclipse.ditto.json.ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler}. It tests JSON parsing functionality, including parsing a JSON array string to a list of JsonValue objects, verifying parsing behavior with null input, and handling empty arrays.

classes.name: ValueListJsonHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler, testing JSON array parsing.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants with sample JSON objects and arrays.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment before each test case.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Tests that parsing a null string throws a JsonParseException caused by NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseEmptyArrayStringToEmptyList
methods.description: Verifies that an empty JSON array string results in an empty list.

methods.name: parseArrayString
methods.description: Tests parsing a JSON array string and verifies the resulting list of JsonValue objects matches expected values.
